authorization_basis: Current user request: test the four- and eight-layer LANGCACHE104 models at one million parameters on Tiny Shakespeare; prior explicit owner authorization permits bounded exploratory CPU fitting without a separate external sign-off.
primary_question: At approximately one million trainable parameters and identical data presentations, how do four wider versus eight narrower LANGCACHE104 layers learn Tiny Shakespeare?

source.representation: unaltered raw byte IDs 0..255; corpus contains 65 ASCII characters
source.split_rule: Contiguous TRAIN first floor(0.90*N), DEV through floor(0.95*N), TEST remainder; source and target always stay within the same partition.

fit.sampling: Uniform legal TRAIN offsets with replacement; independent CPU torch.Generator seeded identically per paired seed for both depths.
fit.state_policy: Reset carried state at each independently sampled training window; preserve differentiation through all 128 bytes.

evaluation.selection: Final checkpoint at exactly step4096 for every registered arm/seed; no best-DEV selection, no adaptive stopping or per-arm tuning.
evaluation.test_policy: One declared final comparison after all six checkpoints pass integrity/replay checks. No TEST-based tuning or checkpoint selection.
evaluation.primary: Full DEV and TEST partitions, reset 128-byte windows, every within-partition next-byte target counted exactly once.
evaluation.secondary: Continuous carried-state evaluation within each partition, reset between partitions; same legal byte history for both depths.
evaluation.aggregation: Report every seed and paired run differences; three runs do not establish general architecture superiority.

generation.vocabulary: all 256 byte IDs; no alphabet filter

evaluation.speed: CPU-only measured prefill and recurrent batch-one decode; persistent tensor bytes and physical backing; full FLOPs and GPU speed unmeasured.

resource_bounds.hardware: GitHub Actions ubuntu CPU; no GPU allocation
resource_bounds.compute_parity: Identical updates/data presentations, closely matched weights; actual CPU time and state sizes reported separately. Full FLOP parity is not established.

interpretation_limits: Within-family depth/width allocation experiment, not an isolated depth intervention or comparison against Transformer/Mamba/BDH.
Eight layers hold twice the number of per-layer cache states; matched weights do not imply matched runtime or state bytes.
Tiny Shakespeare is a small public benchmark, not independent evidence of general language, exact recall, reasoning, or commercial capability.
Owner-authorized exploration does not fabricate independent source/goal/reward/ACL attestation or pass the separate qualified-research gate.
